countries:
CREATE TABLE countries (
	id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	name VARCHAR(120) NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id)
)
courses:
CREATE TABLE courses (
	id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	name VARCHAR(180) NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id)
)
coordinators:
CREATE TABLE coordinators (
	id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	name VARCHAR(180) NOT NULL, 
	email VARCHAR(180), 
	PRIMARY KEY (id)
)
programs:
CREATE TABLE programs (
	id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	name VARCHAR(180) NOT NULL, 
	code VARCHAR(60), 
	PRIMARY KEY (id)
)
semesters:
CREATE TABLE semesters (
	id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	label VARCHAR(12) NOT NULL, 
	year INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	term INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id)
)
students:
CREATE TABLE students (
	id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	full_name VARCHAR(220) NOT NULL, 
	email VARCHAR(180), 
	dre VARCHAR(30), 
	passport VARCHAR(60), 
	nationality VARCHAR(120), 
	PRIMARY KEY (id)
)
universities:
CREATE TABLE universities (
	id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	name VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL, 
	acronym VARCHAR(60), 
	country_id INTEGER, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(country_id) REFERENCES countries (id)
)
mobilities:
CREATE TABLE mobilities (
	id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	direction VARCHAR(12) NOT NULL, 
	student_id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	course_id INTEGER, 
	program_id INTEGER, 
	coordinator_id INTEGER, 
	home_university_id INTEGER, 
	destination_university_id INTEGER, 
	start_semester_id INTEGER, 
	end_semester_id INTEGER, 
	mobility_type VARCHAR(100), 
	duration_semesters INTEGER, 
	status VARCHAR(140), 
	scholarship VARCHAR(120), 
	extension VARCHAR(120), 
	notes TEXT, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(student_id) REFERENCES students (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(course_id) REFERENCES courses (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(program_id) REFERENCES programs (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(coordinator_id) REFERENCES coordinators (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(home_university_id) REFERENCES universities (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(destination_university_id) REFERENCES universities (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(start_semester_id) REFERENCES semesters (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(end_semester_id) REFERENCES semesters (id)
)
agreements:
CREATE TABLE agreements (
	id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	university_id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	agreement_type VARCHAR(150) NOT NULL, 
	sig_number VARCHAR(60), 
	sei_number VARCHAR(80), 
	progress VARCHAR(120), 
	ufrj_stage VARCHAR(120), 
	signed_date DATE, 
	validity_years INTEGER, 
	expiry_date DATE, 
	status VARCHAR(60), 
	drive_folder_url TEXT, 
	ufrj_coordinator VARCHAR(220), 
	notes TEXT, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(university_id) REFERENCES universities (id)
)
incoming_details:
CREATE TABLE incoming_details (
	id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	mobility_id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	candidate_document TEXT, 
	polimail VARCHAR(180), 
	coordination_notes TEXT, 
	intranet_access VARCHAR(100), 
	identification VARCHAR(100), 
	dari_form VARCHAR(100), 
	study_plan TEXT, 
	responsible_name VARCHAR(180), 
	responsible_email VARCHAR(180), 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	UNIQUE (mobility_id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(mobility_id) REFERENCES mobilities (id)
)
outgoing_details:
CREATE TABLE outgoing_details (
	id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	mobility_id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	registration_semester VARCHAR(20), 
	expected_return DATE, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	UNIQUE (mobility_id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(mobility_id) REFERENCES mobilities (id)
)
agreement_actions:
CREATE TABLE agreement_actions (
	id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	agreement_id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	last_action TEXT, 
	last_action_date DATE, 
	next_step TEXT, 
	deadline_text VARCHAR(120), 
	notes TEXT, action_source VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'manual', is_completed BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, created_at DATETIME, completed_at DATETIME, central_action_id INTEGER, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(agreement_id) REFERENCES agreements (id)
)
legado_registros:
CREATE TABLE legado_registros (
        tabela_origem TEXT NOT NULL,
        chave_origem TEXT NOT NULL,
        arquivo_origem TEXT NOT NULL,
        conteudo_json TEXT NOT NULL,
        PRIMARY KEY (tabela_origem, chave_origem))
legado_mapa:
CREATE TABLE legado_mapa (
        tabela_origem TEXT NOT NULL,
        chave_origem TEXT NOT NULL,
        tabela_destino TEXT NOT NULL,
        id_destino INTEGER NOT NULL,
        PRIMARY KEY (tabela_origem, chave_origem, tabela_destino))
legado_importacao:
CREATE TABLE legado_importacao (
        arquivo_origem TEXT NOT NULL,
        sha256_zip TEXT NOT NULL,
        registros_origem INTEGER NOT NULL,
        observacoes TEXT NOT NULL)
historico_fontes_access:
CREATE TABLE historico_fontes_access (
    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, indice TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE, caminho_origem TEXT NOT NULL,
    sha256_access TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE, copias_binarias INTEGER NOT NULL,
    situacao TEXT NOT NULL, detalhe TEXT)
historico_versoes_access:
CREATE TABLE historico_versoes_access (
    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, tabela_origem TEXT NOT NULL, hash_conteudo TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
    conteudo_json_zlib BLOB NOT NULL)
historico_ocorrencias_access:
CREATE TABLE historico_ocorrencias_access (
    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, fonte_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES historico_fontes_access(id),
    tabela_origem TEXT NOT NULL, posicao INTEGER NOT NULL,
    versao_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES historico_versoes_access(id),
    mobilidade_id INTEGER REFERENCES mobilities(id), criterio_vinculo TEXT,
    UNIQUE (fonte_id,tabela_origem,posicao))
historico_casos_pendentes:
CREATE TABLE historico_casos_pendentes (
    chave_grupo TEXT PRIMARY KEY, quantidade_ocorrencias INTEGER NOT NULL,
    quantidade_arquivos INTEGER NOT NULL, motivo TEXT NOT NULL,
    nome_registrado TEXT, dre_registrado TEXT, destino_registrado TEXT,
    ano_inicio INTEGER, primeiro_exemplo_ocorrencia INTEGER,
    ultimo_exemplo_ocorrencia INTEGER, classificacao_pessoa TEXT)
historico_duplicidades_unificadas:
CREATE TABLE historico_duplicidades_unificadas (
    id_access_preservado INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, id_mobilidade_canonica INTEGER NOT NULL,
    tipo TEXT NOT NULL, justificativa TEXT NOT NULL)
historico_campos_recuperados:
CREATE TABLE historico_campos_recuperados (
    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, mobilidade_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES mobilities(id),
    campo_access TEXT NOT NULL, valor_json TEXT NOT NULL,
    fontes_distintas INTEGER NOT NULL, ocorrencias INTEGER NOT NULL,
    resultado TEXT NOT NULL, observacao TEXT,
    UNIQUE (mobilidade_id,campo_access))
historico_divergencias_atributos:
CREATE TABLE historico_divergencias_atributos (
    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, mobilidade_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES mobilities(id),
    campo_access TEXT NOT NULL, valores_distintos INTEGER NOT NULL,
    UNIQUE (mobilidade_id,campo_access))
historico_consolidacao:
CREATE TABLE historico_consolidacao (
    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, data_execucao_utc TEXT NOT NULL,
    sha256_banco_anterior TEXT NOT NULL, arquivos_access_distintos INTEGER NOT NULL,
    ocorrencias_alunos INTEGER NOT NULL, registros_base_antes INTEGER NOT NULL,
    registros_base_depois INTEGER NOT NULL, observacoes TEXT NOT NULL)
historico_planilhas_matheus:
CREATE TABLE historico_planilhas_matheus (
 id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, arquivo TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE, caminho_rar TEXT NOT NULL,
 sha256_xlsx TEXT NOT NULL)
historico_planilhas_matheus_linhas:
CREATE TABLE historico_planilhas_matheus_linhas (
 id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, arquivo_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES historico_planilhas_matheus(id),
 aba TEXT NOT NULL, posicao INTEGER NOT NULL, valores_json_zlib BLOB NOT NULL,
 mobilidade_id INTEGER REFERENCES mobilities(id), criterio_vinculo TEXT,
 UNIQUE (arquivo_id,aba,posicao))
historico_consulta_diretor_linhas:
CREATE TABLE historico_consulta_diretor_linhas (
 id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, posicao_excel INTEGER NOT NULL UNIQUE,
 dados_json TEXT NOT NULL, mobilidade_id INTEGER REFERENCES mobilities(id),
 situacao TEXT NOT NULL)
historico_consulta_diretor_conferencia:
CREATE TABLE historico_consulta_diretor_conferencia (
 id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, arquivo TEXT NOT NULL, total_excel INTEGER NOT NULL,
 total_access INTEGER NOT NULL, comuns_16_colunas INTEGER NOT NULL,
 so_excel_16_colunas INTEGER NOT NULL, so_access_16_colunas INTEGER NOT NULL,
 observacoes TEXT NOT NULL)
historico_copias_binarias_access:
CREATE TABLE historico_copias_binarias_access (
 id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, fonte_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES historico_fontes_access(id),
 nome_copia_original TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE, sha256_access TEXT NOT NULL)
historico_nomes_tabelas_access:
CREATE TABLE historico_nomes_tabelas_access (
 id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, fonte_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES historico_fontes_access(id),
 tabela_importada TEXT NOT NULL, nome_tabela_access TEXT NOT NULL,
 status_leitura TEXT NOT NULL, registros INTEGER NOT NULL,
 UNIQUE (fonte_id,tabela_importada,nome_tabela_access))
historico_acordos_universidades:
CREATE TABLE historico_acordos_universidades (
 universidade_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY REFERENCES universities(id),
 sinalizador_acordo_access INTEGER NOT NULL,
 referencia_processo_access TEXT,
 data_inicio_access TEXT,
 data_fim_access TEXT,
 observacao TEXT NOT NULL)
historico_projetos_universidades:
CREATE TABLE historico_projetos_universidades (
 id_access INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, projeto_id INTEGER REFERENCES programs(id),
 universidade_id INTEGER REFERENCES universities(id), observacao_access TEXT,
 id_projeto_bruto TEXT, id_universidade_bruto TEXT)
historico_coordenadores_cursos:
CREATE TABLE historico_coordenadores_cursos (
 id_access INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, curso_id INTEGER REFERENCES courses(id),
 coordenador_id INTEGER REFERENCES coordinators(id), sala TEXT,
 telefone TEXT,email TEXT,id_curso_bruto TEXT,id_coordenador_bruto TEXT)
historico_migracao_v2_execucao:
CREATE TABLE historico_migracao_v2_execucao (
        id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
        data_execucao_utc TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
        sha256_origem TEXT NOT NULL,
        estudantes_antes INTEGER NOT NULL,
        estudantes_depois INTEGER,
        mobilidades_antes INTEGER NOT NULL,
        mobilidades_depois INTEGER,
        observacoes TEXT
    )
historico_estudantes_unificados_v2:
CREATE TABLE historico_estudantes_unificados_v2 (
        estudante_removido_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
        estudante_canonico_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
        justificativa TEXT NOT NULL,
        dados_removidos_json TEXT NOT NULL
    )
historico_migracao_v2_decisoes:
CREATE TABLE historico_migracao_v2_decisoes (
        chave_grupo TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
        decisao TEXT NOT NULL,
        justificativa TEXT NOT NULL,
        estudante_id INTEGER,
        mobilidade_id INTEGER,
        ocorrencias INTEGER,
        arquivos INTEGER
    )
historico_mobilidades_adicionais_v2:
CREATE TABLE historico_mobilidades_adicionais_v2 (
        mobilidade_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
        chave_grupo TEXT NOT NULL,
        origem TEXT NOT NULL,
        evidencia TEXT NOT NULL
    )
legado_atributos_uteis:
CREATE TABLE legado_atributos_uteis (
        mobility_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
        origem_registro TEXT,
        telefone TEXT,
        curso_nome_historico TEXT,
        codigo_legado TEXT,
        data_retorno_historica TEXT,
        situacao_academica_historica TEXT,
        observacao_access TEXT,
        tipo_mobilidade_historico TEXT,
        prorrogacao_historica TEXT,
        conteudo_access_json TEXT,
        campos_recuperados_json TEXT,
        FOREIGN KEY (mobility_id) REFERENCES mobilities(id)
    )
applications:
CREATE TABLE applications (
	id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	direction VARCHAR(12) NOT NULL, 
	source VARCHAR(80) NOT NULL, 
	source_record_id VARCHAR(180), 
	submitted_at DATETIME, 
	status VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL, 
	first_name VARCHAR(180), 
	surnames VARCHAR(220), 
	full_name VARCHAR(320), 
	email VARCHAR(180), 
	dre VARCHAR(30), 
	passport VARCHAR(60), 
	country_name VARCHAR(120), 
	academic_semester VARCHAR(20), 
	application_type VARCHAR(140), 
	course_name VARCHAR(220), 
	institution_name VARCHAR(255), 
	document_url TEXT, 
	document_local_path TEXT, 
	raw_payload_json TEXT, 
	decision_note TEXT, 
	reviewed_at DATETIME, 
	reviewed_by VARCHAR(120), 
	mobility_id INTEGER, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	CONSTRAINT uq_application_source_record UNIQUE (source, source_record_id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(mobility_id) REFERENCES mobilities (id)
)
user_accounts:
CREATE TABLE user_accounts (
	id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	username VARCHAR(80) NOT NULL, 
	password_hash TEXT NOT NULL, 
	display_name VARCHAR(140), 
	is_admin BOOLEAN NOT NULL, 
	is_active BOOLEAN NOT NULL, 
	can_view_dashboard BOOLEAN NOT NULL, 
	can_view_incoming BOOLEAN NOT NULL, 
	can_edit_incoming BOOLEAN NOT NULL, 
	can_view_outgoing BOOLEAN NOT NULL, 
	can_edit_outgoing BOOLEAN NOT NULL, 
	can_view_acordos BOOLEAN NOT NULL, 
	can_edit_acordos BOOLEAN NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id)
)
integration_sources:
CREATE TABLE integration_sources (
	id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	code VARCHAR(120) NOT NULL, 
	name VARCHAR(220) NOT NULL, 
	source_type VARCHAR(80) NOT NULL, 
	external_id VARCHAR(255), 
	sheet_name VARCHAR(160), 
	read_only BOOLEAN NOT NULL, 
	sync_mode VARCHAR(80), 
	last_sync_at DATETIME, 
	last_sync_status VARCHAR(60), 
	last_sync_message TEXT, 
	last_item_count INTEGER, 
	last_created INTEGER, 
	last_updated INTEGER, 
	last_archived INTEGER, 
	config_json TEXT, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id)
)
agreement_source_records:
CREATE TABLE agreement_source_records (
	id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	source_id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	agreement_id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	source_key VARCHAR(500) NOT NULL, 
	identity_key VARCHAR(500), 
	source_hash VARCHAR(64), 
	action_hash VARCHAR(64), 
	source_occurrences INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	source_rows_json TEXT, 
	source_payload_json TEXT, 
	source_deleted BOOLEAN NOT NULL, 
	first_seen_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	last_seen_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	deleted_at DATETIME, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	CONSTRAINT uq_agreement_source_key UNIQUE (source_id, source_key), 
	FOREIGN KEY(source_id) REFERENCES integration_sources (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(agreement_id) REFERENCES agreements (id)
)
incoming_source_batches:
CREATE TABLE incoming_source_batches (
	id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	source_sha256 VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	original_filename VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL, 
	imported_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	imported_rows INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	imported_sheets INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	imported_tables INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	read_only_source BOOLEAN NOT NULL, 
	operational_promotion VARCHAR(40) NOT NULL, 
	technical_notes TEXT, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id)
)
incoming_source_worksheets:
CREATE TABLE incoming_source_worksheets (
	id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	batch_id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	sheet_name VARCHAR(130) NOT NULL, 
	sheet_order INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	sheet_kind VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL, 
	max_row INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	max_col INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	nonempty_rows INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	formula_cells INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	hyperlink_cells INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	validation_rules INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	hidden BOOLEAN NOT NULL, 
	original_headers_json TEXT NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	CONSTRAINT uq_incoming_sheet_per_batch UNIQUE (batch_id, sheet_name), 
	FOREIGN KEY(batch_id) REFERENCES incoming_source_batches (id)
)
incoming_source_tables:
CREATE TABLE incoming_source_tables (
	id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	batch_id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	table_name VARCHAR(110) NOT NULL, 
	sheet_name VARCHAR(130) NOT NULL, 
	sheet_range VARCHAR(60) NOT NULL, 
	column_labels_json TEXT NOT NULL, 
	is_header_only BOOLEAN NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	CONSTRAINT uq_incoming_table_per_batch UNIQUE (batch_id, table_name), 
	FOREIGN KEY(batch_id) REFERENCES incoming_source_batches (id)
)
incoming_source_rows:
CREATE TABLE incoming_source_rows (
	id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	batch_id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	sheet_name VARCHAR(130) NOT NULL, 
	source_row INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	row_kind VARCHAR(60) NOT NULL, 
	source_key VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL, 
	row_sha256 VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	raw_values_json TEXT NOT NULL, 
	field_values_json TEXT NOT NULL, 
	normalized_json TEXT NOT NULL, 
	hyperlink_json TEXT NOT NULL, 
	formulas_json TEXT NOT NULL, 
	nonempty BOOLEAN NOT NULL, 
	redacted_credentials INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	review_status VARCHAR(40) NOT NULL, 
	student_id INTEGER, 
	mobility_id INTEGER, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	CONSTRAINT uq_incoming_row_position UNIQUE (batch_id, sheet_name, source_row), 
	CONSTRAINT uq_incoming_source_key_batch UNIQUE (batch_id, source_key), 
	FOREIGN KEY(batch_id) REFERENCES incoming_source_batches (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(student_id) REFERENCES students (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(mobility_id) REFERENCES mobilities (id)
)
incoming_source_annotations:
CREATE TABLE incoming_source_annotations (
	id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	batch_id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	sheet_name VARCHAR(130) NOT NULL, 
	cell VARCHAR(30) NOT NULL, 
	annotation_type VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL, 
	author VARCHAR(250), 
	content TEXT, 
	source_part VARCHAR(255), 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(batch_id) REFERENCES incoming_source_batches (id)
)
incoming_country_alias_proposals:
CREATE TABLE incoming_country_alias_proposals (
	id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	batch_id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	source_value VARCHAR(200) NOT NULL, 
	canonical_name VARCHAR(200), 
	occurrences INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	review_required BOOLEAN NOT NULL, 
	explanation TEXT, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	CONSTRAINT uq_incoming_country_alias UNIQUE (batch_id, source_value), 
	FOREIGN KEY(batch_id) REFERENCES incoming_source_batches (id)
)
incoming_university_variants:
CREATE TABLE incoming_university_variants (
	id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	batch_id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	source_value VARCHAR(500) NOT NULL, 
	normalized_text VARCHAR(500) NOT NULL, 
	occurrences INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	example_sheet VARCHAR(130) NOT NULL, 
	legacy_exact_match BOOLEAN NOT NULL, 
	review_required BOOLEAN NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	CONSTRAINT uq_incoming_university_variant UNIQUE (batch_id, source_value), 
	FOREIGN KEY(batch_id) REFERENCES incoming_source_batches (id)
)
incoming_import_issues:
CREATE TABLE incoming_import_issues (
	id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	batch_id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	code VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL, 
	severity VARCHAR(40) NOT NULL, 
	sheet_name VARCHAR(130), 
	source_row INTEGER, 
	details TEXT NOT NULL, 
	recommendation TEXT, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(batch_id) REFERENCES incoming_source_batches (id)
)
incoming_field_evidence:
CREATE TABLE incoming_field_evidence (
	id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	source_row_id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	field_key VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL, 
	value_json TEXT NOT NULL, 
	proposed_destination VARCHAR(170) NOT NULL, 
	semantic_group VARCHAR(70) NOT NULL, 
	requires_review BOOLEAN NOT NULL, 
	review_status VARCHAR(45) NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	CONSTRAINT uq_incoming_field_per_row UNIQUE (source_row_id, field_key), 
	FOREIGN KEY(source_row_id) REFERENCES incoming_source_rows (id)
)
incoming_semester_activity_evidence:
CREATE TABLE incoming_semester_activity_evidence (
	id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	source_row_id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	reference_semester VARCHAR(12) NOT NULL, 
	evidence_kind VARCHAR(60) NOT NULL, 
	confirmation VARCHAR(45) NOT NULL, 
	student_id INTEGER, 
	mobility_id INTEGER, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	CONSTRAINT uq_incoming_active_source_row UNIQUE (source_row_id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(source_row_id) REFERENCES incoming_source_rows (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(student_id) REFERENCES students (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(mobility_id) REFERENCES mobilities (id)
)
incoming_operational_supplements:
CREATE TABLE incoming_operational_supplements (
	id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	mobility_id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	alternate_email TEXT, 
	coordination_opinion TEXT, 
	letter_status TEXT, 
	registration_dre_status TEXT, 
	internal_process_note TEXT, 
	expected_arrival_notes TEXT, 
	operational_notes TEXT, 
	internship_details TEXT, 
	administrative_status TEXT, 
	expected_arrival DATE, 
	confirmed_arrival DATE, 
	expected_departure DATE, 
	confirmed_departure DATE, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(mobility_id) REFERENCES mobilities (id)
)
incoming_field_promotions:
CREATE TABLE incoming_field_promotions (
	id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	source_row_id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	mobility_id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	field_key VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL, 
	source_row_sha256 VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	value_sha256 VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	applied_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	CONSTRAINT uq_incoming_promotion_source_field UNIQUE (source_row_id, field_key), 
	FOREIGN KEY(source_row_id) REFERENCES incoming_source_rows (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(mobility_id) REFERENCES mobilities (id)
)
incoming_identity_candidates:
CREATE TABLE incoming_identity_candidates (
 id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
 identity_key TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
 full_name TEXT NOT NULL,
 normalized_name TEXT NOT NULL,
 dre_text TEXT,
 identity_method TEXT NOT NULL,
 review_status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'needs_review',
 created_at TEXT NOT NULL
)
incoming_period_registry:
CREATE TABLE incoming_period_registry (
 id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
 source_row_id INTEGER NOT NULL UNIQUE REFERENCES incoming_source_rows(id),
 candidate_id INTEGER REFERENCES incoming_identity_candidates(id),
 linked_student_id INTEGER REFERENCES students(id),

 source_semester TEXT,
 source_kind TEXT NOT NULL,
 registry_status TEXT NOT NULL,
 country_id INTEGER REFERENCES countries(id),

)
incoming_country_normalization:
CREATE TABLE incoming_country_normalization (
 id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
 source_value TEXT UNIQUE NOT NULL,
 proposed_canonical TEXT,
 resolved_country_id INTEGER REFERENCES countries(id),

 review_reason TEXT
)
incoming_university_normalization:
CREATE TABLE incoming_university_normalization (
 id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
 source_value TEXT UNIQUE NOT NULL,
 existing_university_id INTEGER REFERENCES universities(id),
 confidence TEXT NOT NULL,
 suggestion TEXT,
 review_reason TEXT
)
incoming_field_conflicts:
CREATE TABLE incoming_field_conflicts (
 id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
 source_row_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES incoming_source_rows(id),
 mobility_id INTEGER REFERENCES mobilities(id),
 field_name TEXT NOT NULL,
 existing_value TEXT,
 incoming_value TEXT,
 reason TEXT NOT NULL,
 UNIQUE(source_row_id, field_name, reason)
)
incoming_name_decisions:
CREATE TABLE incoming_name_decisions (
 id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
 student_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES students(id),
 dre TEXT NOT NULL,
 sheet_name TEXT NOT NULL,
 source_row INTEGER NOT NULL,
 name_before TEXT NOT NULL,
 name_source_cleaned TEXT NOT NULL,
 name_approved TEXT NOT NULL,
 review_decision TEXT NOT NULL,

 source_review_sha256 TEXT NOT NULL,
 decided_at TEXT NOT NULL,

)
incoming_v47_links:
CREATE TABLE incoming_v47_links (
 id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
 source_row_id INTEGER NOT NULL UNIQUE REFERENCES incoming_source_rows(id),
 student_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES students(id),
 mobility_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES mobilities(id),
 source_row_sha256 TEXT NOT NULL,
 evidence TEXT NOT NULL,
 created_at TEXT NOT NULL
)
incoming_v48_review_approvals:
CREATE TABLE incoming_v48_review_approvals (
 id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
 source_row_id INTEGER NOT NULL UNIQUE REFERENCES incoming_source_rows(id),
 student_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES students(id),
 mobility_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES mobilities(id),
 source_row_sha256 TEXT NOT NULL,
